free_tier.stated: The page is titled 'Server rental from 1200 roubles' and its own line reads 'from 1200 RUB a month'. The list behind it holds a Xeon E3-1240v6 at 3.7 GHz with 64 GB DDR4 ECC and 4 x 4 TB SATA, several E3-1220v6 machines with 32 GB DDR4 ECC, a Core i3-2100 with 8 GB DDR3 and 2 x 500 GB Enterprise disks, and an E3-1220 at 3.1 GHz with 8 GB DDR3 ECC and 2 x 1 TB Enterprise disks marked 20 percent off. Every row includes built-in KVM over IP and IPMI access.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: A Russian machine at RUB 1200 with IPMI and unlimited traffic is the cheapest dedicated hardware found anywhere, and it composes with a Western front end because the machine is the back end and latency does not matter for batch work.
limits_note: The traffic claim is 'absolutely unlimited' with no rate, which is a discretionary throttle and not a quota.

configurations listed: 'Xeon E3-1240v6, 3,7 GHz | RAM 64 GB DDR4 ECC | 4x4000 GB SATA', 'Xeon E3-1220v6 3.0 GHz | RAM 32 GB DDR4 ECC | 2x2000 GB SAS + RAID', 'Core i3-2100 3,1 GHz | RAM 8 GB DDR3 | 2x0,5 TB HDD Enterprise RAID1/RAID0', 'XEON E3-1220 3,1 GHz skidka 20% | RAM 8 GB DDR3 ECC | 2x1 TB HDD Enterprise', each with 'vstroennyy KVM over IP, IPMI-dostup'
the page states 'Absolyutno bezlimitnyy trafik' and 'Skidki do 60% pri opolate za 3, 6, 12 mesyatsev', so the monthly figure is the worst price and annual prepayment discounts up to 60 percent

a Russian survey of dedicated rental puts entry at '110 RUB/mo at 4VPS, 139 RUB at RuVDS, 180 RUB at Timeweb, 200 RUB at Selectel, 235 RUB at REG.ru, 299 RUB at AdminVPS, 350 RUB at IQHost, 503 RUB at Fornex, 593 RUB at Ayeza and 605 RUB at ISHosting'

notes: Two limits on the number. The E3-1220 row marked 20 percent off is the nearest candidate and the shape here is that candidate, inferred. And the Russian aggregator's entry prices of 110 and 139 roubles cannot be whole machines at any plausible exchange rate, so a reader comparing across providers should treat a Russian 'dedicated' entry price as a VPS-class slice until the configuration is read. No rouble-to-dollar conversion is given because no rate was read.
